mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when UNRATE exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based consumer demand contraction that triggers corporate revenue revisions downward, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in more than 60% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of industrial production below 100 (INDPRO) and decelerating GDP growth (GDPC1 growth rate < 2.0% annualized) signals supply-side economic constraints that reduce corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO < 100 and GDPC1 growth rate < 2.0% annualized.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) over the prior quarter signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases by at least 100,000 jobs over the prior quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI increase exceeding 3.0% signals accelerating inflation that prompts Federal Reserve tightening, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and year-over-year CPI (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) signal active monetary tightening in response to inflation, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL > 3.0% fails to predict negative returns in more than 60% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A regime of high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) combined with weak job growth (PAYEMS growth rate < 0.5% monthly) signals labor market contraction that reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0% and PAYEMS growth rate < 0.5% monthly.
